// diagnostic

E0084

Text {position} `"""` is not allowed

What

Text {position} `"""` is not allowed

Why

Only spaces or tabs may follow the opening quotes or precede the closing quotes on their line.

Fix

Move the text to its own line, or use an ordinary string or a backtick raw string for one line of text.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0084: tests/ui/triple_delimiter_both.stderr.

 Why: Only spaces or tabs may follow the opening quotes or precede the closing quotes on their line.
 Fix: Move the text to its own line, or use an ordinary string or a backtick raw string for one line of text.
